notes.title: Bee Welcome! More Languages!
notes.content:
Hi, my dear Bee friend! ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893032/95588da06637a5706112a8ebc338f493baef5a36.png[/img]

I have good news! Now we have added some more languages for you:

- Brazilian Portuguese
- Chinese simplified
- English (reworked)
- French
- Japanese
- Korean
- Polish
- Russian
- Spanish

If you spot mistakes in your language feel free to let me know! ☘️

We also reworked some pain points. You may have seen my video, where I'm stating that level 3 is too difficult and the actual level 3 is easier... which was a LIE!!?! 🤯
We weren't aware of having (again) a way to hard level 3 😅 So finally level 3 is beatable and fair with this update!✌️
We also reworked one heart- and the pizza-bee.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2837750/Bee_Welcome/

Hope you like it!
Stay tuned for the full game ~
Anke ~
